reasons: Image 1 (Crop-identity Overview): Functions well as a crop-overview shot, showing extensive field rows and the AFP product, although the crop morphology (tall, lance-leaf plants) is more consistent with cereals like corn rather than squash/pumpkin.

No people are present in the images.
